item.title: [GKIDS Films] THE LAST BLOSSOM | Official Trailer - In theatres August 30 & 31
item.description:
THE LAST BLOSSOM
From Baku Kinoshita
In theatres August 30 & 31
Follow @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
https://brnw.ch/21x4vjI

Former yakuza Akutsu is serving life in prison after a middling career in the underworld. On the night he lays dying in his cell, he reminisces with his only companion, a smart-mouthed flower growing out of a can, about the choices that brought him here, the woman he loved, and a child he would give everything to protect. Is redemption out of reach?

From director Baku Kinoshita and writer Kazuya Konomoto, creators of ODDTAXI, and award-winning Studio CLAP (Pompo the Cinephile), THE LAST BLOSSOM is a thrillingly original work from animation’s most inventive new talent. Moving across time and memory, the film is an unforgettable meditation on found family, sacrifice, and the complicated pieces that join together to make a life.

©Kazuya Konomoto /The Last Blossom Production Committee

item.title: [GKIDS Films] Your Name. | Official Trailer - In theatres August 14
item.description:
Your Name.
From Makoto Shinkai
In theatres starting August 14
Follow @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
https://brnw.ch/21x4tnv

One morning, rural schoolgirl Mitsuha and city kid Taki awaken to discover that they’ve switched bodies. The total strangers struggle to navigate each other’s lives, walking tightropes of intimacy and distance. But when they finally resolve to meet, the true nature of their connection threatens to seal their fate.

Instantly iconic, Your Name. was a worldwide smash hit and heralded writer/director Makoto Shinkai as a new great master of animation. Its sumptuous attention to detail in yearning vistas and pulsing city streets, driven by an unforgettable score from RADWIMPS, elevates its central romance to world-rending levels of destiny and longing.

© 2016 "Your Name." Film Partners

item.title: [GKIDS Films] KIKI'S DELIVERY SERVICE | Official Trailer - In UK & IE cinemas 21 August
item.description:
KIKI'S DELIVERY SERVICE
From Hayao Miyazaki and Studio Ghibli
4K remaster in IMAX cinemas in the UK & Ireland starting 21 August

Screening in both the original Japanese w/ English subtitles and English dub

KIKI’S DELIVERY SERVICE, the timeless and beloved classic from Academy Award®-winning director Hayao Miyazaki and globally celebrated animation house Studio Ghibli, comes to cinemas in the UK and Ireland, presented newly remastered in 4K, exclusively in IMAX® theatres. The release marks the first time ever that KIKI’S DELIVERY SERVICE will play on IMAX® screens in the UK and Ireland. Tickets are on sale now with showings in both the original Japanese language with subtitles and English language dubbed versions.

The upcoming IMAX® release follows this month’s earlier announcement that GKIDS had acquired the UK and Ireland distribution rights to the 23 film-library of Japan’s renowned Studio Ghibli, one of the most acclaimed and influential animation studios in the world. Additionally announced future titles slated to come to IMAX® screens in the UK and Ireland include ARRIETTY and WHISPER OF THE HEART. Like GKIDS and IMAX®’s partnership in North America, fans can look forward to additional IMAX® releases of new Studio Ghibli 4K Remasters in Fall 2026 and beyond, plus the re-release of the entire library across all home video platforms.
